Riley: Quick follow-up from the postmortem  need owners + firm ETAs for the DR/regional failover action items. Reply exactly: owner: action  ETA (date).

Tara: Tara: owner: routing reconciler CI job  action: add deploy-time diff for route tables across regions + fail-open flag  ETA: 2026-04-10.

Ethan: Ethan: owner: snapshot verification hook  action: post-snapshot integrity check + metadata of base snap id, surface in playbook  ETA: 2026-04-08.

Sam: Sam: owner: restore runbook revamp  action: step-by-step partial and full region restore, estimate RTOs, add rollback steps  ETA: 2026-04-06.

Riley: Noted. Two recurring patterns: 1) inconsistent route state during rapid autoscale, 2) longer-than-expected restore due to incomplete incremental chains. Call out cross-team blockers in one short sentence when you post ETA.

Tara: Risk: needs platform CI capacity in target regions; may wait for sprint window.

Ethan: Risk: will need storage team for snapshot chain tests; may require short test window.

Sam: Risk: needs reserved staging GPUs for dry-run; Ops to confirm.

OpsBot: OpsBot: created event "DR regional failover dry-run" 2026-04-12 09:00 UTC, playbook stub: https://internal.redwood/playbooks/dr-dry-run. Invitees: oncall, platform, storage, network.

Riley: Thanks. Plan: owners, open PRs or tickets and link them in the continuity playbook by EOD Friday. We'll do a 20-min sync next Tue to validate progress. :thumbsup:
